prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration with tactile ceramic, cut paper, translucent glass and porous limestone. Ivory #F7F6F2, cobalt #1547BB, vermilion #EF383E, restrained charcoal. Gallery studio lighting, bold clear composition, material grain and realistic cast shadows. No text, readable characters, numerals, logos, flags, watermarks or identifiable people. A conceptual scene, not documentary evidence, an actual chart or data map, or accusation against a real institution. Wide cover1200:630. A quiet ivory architectural classroom miniature has several windows: two open wide toward pale daylight and two partly covered by cobalt slatted blinds. Simple unoccupied desks, one closed red book at the front. Balanced perspective, no flags, school identifiers or chalkboard writing. Metaphor for conditions of inquiry, not a specific university.
